---
title: {{title}}
abstract: {{abstract}}
date: {{date}}
lang: {{language}}
engine: markdown
from: markdown-raw_tex-raw_html-yaml_metadata_block
slide-level: 2
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    embed-resources: true
    format-links: false
    toc: true
    number-sections: false
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        body { font-family: "Noto Sans JP", sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.8; color: #20252b; }
        main.content { max-width: 44rem; }
        h1, h2, a { color: #922E41; }
        h1.title { font-size: 34px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 600; }
        main h1, main h2 { font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 2rem; }
        main p { margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
        main table { font-size: 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
        .exhibit-note { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: #434343; }
        .columns { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; }
        .column { min-width: 0; }
        img { max-width: 100%; }
        </style>
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: lualatex
    documentclass: econsocart
    cite-method: natbib
    biblio-style: ecta-fullname
    keep-tex: true
    CJKmainfont: HaranoAjiMincho
    CJKsansfont: HaranoAjiGothic
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \makeatletter\@ifpackageloaded{babel}{\babeladjust{bidi.text=off}}{}\makeatother
  revealjs:
    theme: simple
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    margin: 0.07
    center: false
    slide-number: c/t
    navigation-mode: linear
    transition: none
    controls: true
    progress: true
    embed-resources: true
    html-math-method:
      method: mathjax
      url: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/tex-chtml-full.js
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        :root { --r-main-font: "Noto Sans JP", sans-serif; --r-heading-font: "Noto Sans JP", sans-serif; --r-main-font-size: 28pt; --r-heading-color: #922E41; --r-link-color: #922E41; }
        .reveal { line-height: 1.45; color: #20252b; }
        .reveal h2 { font-size: 32pt; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 28px; text-transform: none; }
        .reveal h1 { font-size: 40pt; line-height: 1.25; text-transform: none; }
        .reveal .slides section { text-align: left; }
        .reveal p { margin: 0 0 22px; }
        .reveal li { margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .reveal .exhibit-note { font-size: 28pt; line-height: 1.4; color: #434343; margin-top: 20px; }
        .reveal table { font-size: 28pt; line-height: 1.4; width: 100%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 24px 0; }
        .reveal table th, .reveal table td { padding: .4em .55em; vertical-align: middle; }
        .reveal table thead { color: #922E41; border-top: 2px solid #922E41; }
        .reveal table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 1px solid #434343; }
        .reveal img { max-height: 425px; object-fit: contain; margin: .3em auto; }
        .reveal .column img { max-height: 430px; }
        .reveal .columns { gap: 1.2em; }
        .reveal .slides section .fragment { opacity: 1; }
        </style>
  beamer:
    latex-auto-install: false
    pdf-engine: lualatex
    aspectratio: 169
    theme: metropolis
    keep-tex: true
  gfm: default
execute:
  enabled: false
  freeze: true
---

{{body}}
